title: Find a research position by field
subtitle: Pick a discipline to see researchers who are actively publishing in it, what they work on, and how to reach out.
blurb: Find {field} researchers who are actively publishing, understand what they work on, and write a specific note that actually gets read.
pageSubtitle: Discover who is publishing in {field} right now, understand their work, and reach out the right way.
tip1: Skim two or three recent abstracts before writing — you only need enough to ask one good question.
tip2: Mention a concrete skill: a course, a dataset, a tool or a small project. Lab tasks are usually practical.
tip3: Offer a specific number of hours and a start date. It makes yes easier.
tip4: If the professor isn't taking students, ask who in the group might be.
